metadata.subject: MATHEMATICS & PHYSICAL SCIENCE

general_instructions: Conducted on Day 4 Morning (06:40 AM – 07:45 AM).
Audits multi-subject retention from Days 1 to 3: Mathematics (13M) + Physical Science (12M).
Section A comprises 5 Objective / Competency questions (1 mark each).
Section B comprises 3 Conceptual Short Questions (2 marks each).
Section C comprises 3 Numerical / Application Questions (3 marks each).
Section D comprises 1 Core Derivation / Diagram Question (5 marks).
Final 10 minutes (07:30 – 07:40 AM) reserved for Underline Protocol & SI Unit verification.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Which of the following algebraic identities is universally correct for all real values of a and b?

sections.section_title: PART 1: MATHEMATICS — SECTION B: VERY SHORT ANSWER

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise the algebraic expression completely by grouping terms: 15xy - 6x + 5y - 2.

sections.section_title: PART 1: MATHEMATICS — SECTION C: SHORT ANSWER & NUMERICAL

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A cuboid has dimensions 60 cm x 54 cm x 30 cm. How many small cubes with side 6 cm can be placed in the given cuboid?

sections.section_title: PART 1: MATHEMATICS — SECTION D: LONG ANSWER & DERIVATION

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
(a) A closed cylindrical storage tank of radius 7 m and height 3 m is made from a sheet of metal. How much sheet of metal is required? (Take π = 22/7).
(b) If the metal costs ₹ 45 per square meter, calculate the total cost.

sections.section_title: PART 2: PHYSICAL SCIENCE (12 MARKS) — SECTION A: OBJECTIVE & ASSERTION-REASON

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.text: Pressure is defined as the force acting per unit area of a surface. Its standard S.I. unit is:

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.text:
ASSERTION (A): The shoulder strap of a school bag is made broad.
REASON (R): A broad strap increases the surface area of contact, thereby reducing the pressure exerted on the shoulder.
options: (a) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is correct explanation.
(b) Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT correct explanation.

sections.section_title: PART 2: PHYSICAL SCIENCE — SECTION B: VERY SHORT CONCEPT DRILL

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.text: Why is rolling friction substantially less than sliding friction? Give one practical engineering application where sliding friction is replaced by rolling friction.

sections.section_title: PART 2: PHYSICAL SCIENCE — SECTION C: SHORT ANSWER & APPLICATION

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.text: A wooden block of dimensions 20 cm x 10 cm x 5 cm of mass 4 kg is kept on a tabletop. Calculate the maximum pressure exerted by the block on the tabletop in Pascals. (Take g = 10 m/s²).

sections.section_title: PART 2: PHYSICAL SCIENCE — SECTION D: LONG ANSWER & DIAGRAM TASK

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.text:
(a) State the two Laws of Reflection of Light.
(b) Draw a neat labeled ray diagram showing the incident ray, reflected ray, normal line, angle of incidence (i) and angle of reflection (r).
